data.one_liner: Flutter client library for receiving Server-Sent Events (SSE) over HTTP.
data.what_it_does: Allows establishing Server-Sent Events connections using the HTTP package to receive real-time updates from servers. It supports custom request parameters, automatic reconnections with exponential backoff, and dynamic data deserialization.
use_when: You need to stream real-time updates from a backend server via Server-Sent Events.
You want automatic retry logic and connection failure handling for SSE streams.
avoid_when: You need bi-directional real-time communication via WebSockets instead of unidirectional SSE.
strengths: Supports automatic reconnection with exponential backoff on connection failures
Allows custom headers and dynamic deserialization of received data
Handles both GET and POST requests for SSE streams
weaknesses: Limited to unidirectional server-sent event streams
Relies solely on the HTTP package for underlying network requests

alternatives.name: web_socket_channel
alternatives.why_pick_it: Choose this if you require full bi-directional communication via WebSockets instead of unidirectional server-sent events.

alternatives.name: http
alternatives.why_pick_it: Choose this if you only need standard request-response HTTP operations without built-in SSE stream handling.
